title: From Cases to Criteria: Reusing Evaluation Knowledge for Task-Specific Rubric Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Query-specific rubrics make LLM evaluation more fine-grained and transparent, and generating high-quality rubrics requires both identifying the target query's evaluation scope and specifying concrete checks. Historical rubrics provide reusable evaluation experiences, yet existing approaches reuse either complete query-rubric cases or aggregated criteria and dimensions without explicitly connecting recurring evaluation requirements to their criterion-level evidence and source-query context. This can preserve irrelevant task details or lose the broader evaluation structure. In this paper, we introduce RubricDuo, which organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared concepts, local concepts, criteria, and queries, where reusable evaluation requirements across queries are abstracted by shared concepts. translated_title: 从案例到准则：复用评估知识以生成任务特定的评分细则
translated_abstract: 查询特定的评分细则能够使大语言模型（LLM）的评估更加细粒度和透明，而生成高质量的评分细则既需要识别目标查询的评估范围，又需要明确具体的检查项。历史评分细则提供了可复用的评估经验，然而现有方法要么复用完整的查询-评分细则案例，要么复用聚合后的准则与维度，未能将重复出现的评估需求显式地与其准则层面的证据以及源查询上下文相关联。这可能导致保留无关的任务细节，或丢失更广泛的评估结构。在本文中，我们提出了 RubricDuo，它将历史查询-评分细则对组织成一个评分细则知识图谱，链接评估维度、共享概念、局部概念、准则和查询，其中跨查询的可复用评估需求通过共享概念进行抽象。给定一个目标查询，RubricDuo 首先结合与目标查询相关的概念……
tldr: 提出 RubricDuo，通过构建链接评估维度、共享概念、局部概念、准则与查询的评分细则知识图谱来复用历史评估知识，从而为 LLM 评估自动生成任务特定、细粒度且结构完整的查询级评分细则。
en_tdlr: RubricDuo organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared/local concepts, criteria, and queries, enabling reuse of evaluation knowledge to generate fine-grained, task-specific rubrics for LLM evaluation.
